Construct a joint crossbasis matrix for two interacting exposures

joint.crossbasis.Rd

Constructs a distributed lag non-linear model (DLNM) crossbasis for the interaction between two exposure variables. The exposures can be supplied either as concurrent time series or as pre-computed lagged exposure histories.

Usage

joint.crossbasis(
  x = NULL,
  lag = 10,
  arglag = list(),
  argvar1 = list(),
  argvar2 = list(),
  group = NULL,
  is_identifiable = TRUE
)

Arguments

x

A matrix or a list containing the exposure variables. If a matrix, the first and second columns contain the time series of the first and second exposure, respectively. If a list, x[[1]] and x[[2]] should contain the lagged exposure histories for the first and second exposure.

lag

Integer specifying the maximum lag.

arglag

A named list of arguments defining the basis for the lag dimension (e.g., fun, knots, nk, df, degree, Boundary.knots).

argvar1

A named list of arguments defining the basis for the first exposure dimension (e.g., fun, knots, nk, df, degree, Boundary.knots).

argvar2

A named list of arguments defining the basis for the second exposure dimension (e.g., fun, knots, nk, df, degree, Boundary.knots).

group

An optional factor or vector identifying groups of observations belonging to independent time series.

is_identifiable

Logical; if TRUE (default), constructs an identifiable basis by removing confounded terms.

Value

A joint crossbasis matrix representing the interaction between two exposure variables across the specified lag period.
